app.title.zh: 人生七年：从 7 岁到 70 岁

overview.title.zh: 14 个人，从 7 岁到 70 岁

overview.lede.zh: 每条线是一个人，按 1964 年的出身分组上色。拖动滑杆，看同一年龄时每个人的状态。
overview.lede.en: Each line is one person, coloured by where they started in 1964. Drag the slider to compare everyone at the same age.

overview.groupHint.en: Click a group to highlight it

overview.lifelineAria.zh: 14 位人物在十部影片中的出镜生命线
overview.lifelineAria.en: Lifelines of the 14 participants across the ten films

legend.absent.zh: 未出镜 / 只有旧片段

person.questions.zh: 在问题库中查看全部 {n} 个问题
person.questions.en: See all {n} questions in the library

compare.lede.zh: 任选两个人：十个年龄排成列，六个维度排成行，逐格对照。点一个格子可以看出处。
compare.lede.en: Pick two people: ten ages across, six dimensions down. Click a cell to see its sources.

questions.lede.zh: 十部片里导演问过的问题。点开一条，可以看到回答要点、出处，以及同一个人在其他年龄被问到的同类问题。
questions.lede.en: Questions the film-makers asked across the ten films. Open one to see the answer in brief, the source, and similar questions to the same person at other ages.

questions.empty.zh: 没有找到符合条件的问题。

questions.related.zh: 同类问题 · 其他年龄

guess.title.en: Guess: does seven make the man?

guess.lede.zh: 每轮给出一个孩子 1964 年的出身和 7 岁时说的话，猜猜这个人最后的样子。三个选项都是真实的结局，其中两个属于别人。
guess.lede.en: Each round shows one child’s 1964 background and something they said at seven. Guess where they ended up. All three options are real outcomes — two belong to other people.

guess.noPrompt.en: Their words at seven could not be confirmed.

guess.question.en: Where do you think this child ended up?

guess.score.zh: 已经猜了 {n} 个，猜中 {k} 个

guess.done.zh: 你从 7 岁看到了最后，{n} 个人里猜中了 {k} 个。
guess.done.en: From seven to the end: you got {k} of {n}.

guess.doneSub.zh: 这部片的出发点是“七岁看老”。你的结果，离它有多远？
guess.doneSub.en: The series began with “give me the child until seven”. How close did you come?

guess.hiddenName.zh: 名字先藏起来，揭晓时再显示。
guess.hiddenName.en: The name stays hidden until you reveal.

origins.kicker.zh: 英国纪录片《人生七年》（Up 系列），1964—2026

origins.themesTitle.zh: 导演问了什么，想了解什么
origins.themesTitle.en: What the film-makers asked, and why

origins.themesLede.zh: 按主题整理。每张卡片给出一个代表性的问题，以及这类问题背后的意图：有出处的引用原话，没有出处的标为“解读”。点开进入问题库。
origins.themesLede.en: Grouped by theme. Each card shows a representative question and the intent behind it — quoted where a source says so, marked “interpretation” where it does not. Click to open the library.

about.purpose.zh: 这是一个个人整理的可视化项目，与 ITV、BBC 及影片制作方没有关联。
about.purpose.en: An independent visualization. Not affiliated with ITV, the BBC or the film-makers.

about.sources.zh: 所有事实都来自公开资料：维基百科、新闻报道与影评、访谈，以及影片本身。每条事实都标了出处；查不到的就写“未查到”，不做推测。
about.sources.en: Every fact comes from public sources — Wikipedia, news coverage and reviews, interviews, and the films themselves — and carries its source. Where nothing could be found the page says “Not found” rather than guessing.

about.copyright.zh: 片中内容只收录导演提问的原文；回答用我们自己的话转述。原话摘录每人每部片最多 3 条、每条不超过两句。不收录截图、视频或字幕全文。
about.copyright.en: From the films we include the interviewers’ questions verbatim; answers are paraphrased in our own words. Direct quotes are capped at three per person per film, two sentences each. No stills, video or full transcripts.

about.translation.zh: 中文译文由 AI 翻译，可能有不准确之处；在中文模式下，鼠标悬停在问答上可以看到英文原文。
about.translation.en: Chinese translations are machine-made (AI) and may be imperfect; in Chinese mode, hover over a question or quote to see the English original.
